item.name: Outrigger Canoe Charter
item.description:
#OUTRIGGER CANOE SURFING is the original Hawaiian rollercoaster ride! Waikīkī Beach is currently the only place where a visitor can experience the thrill of surfing a wave on an outrigger canoe.


##Options & Prices:
- **1hr Canoe Charter** $400 per canoe/ Maximum of 6 riders. No minimum number of riders required.


##Additional Information:
 - Canoe runs daily from 10:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.
 - Same-day reservations must visit or call our activity desk at (808) 388-1510.
 - Up to 6 people can fit per canoe (4 paddlers + 2 riders).
 - Ages 5+ welcome – parent or guardian must be present to hold child during the ride and must provide own lifejacket or floatation device.
 - All swimming and paddling abilities also welcome.
 - Life jackets for adults are available upon request.

The canoe operates under the guidance of certified first and second canoe captains, who will assist guests with paddling and navigating thru the surf. Your group will paddle out to the surfbreak and get in the line up to catch some waves.

Safety is of the utmost importance to us; in times of large surf or unpredictable ocean conditions, it may not be possible to use the canoe safely. In cases such as these, we will try to give us much warning as possible should we need to cancel or reschedule a booking.

#Check-In

Please check-in at least 10–15 minutes before your booked time at our service counter located on the pool deck of the Royal Hawaiian Hotel at 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI. 96815.  

Find your way to the beach by taking the surfboard lined public beach access walkway that is located between The Cheesecake Factory (restaurant) and The Outrigger Waikīkī on the Beach (hotel) on Kalākaua Ave. Continue down this path until you have reached the sand. facts.hygiene_policy:
Your safety and the safety of our staff are our highest priorities. All participants, including minors, must complete an electronic liability waiver before participating in any Waikīkī Beach Services activity or rental. A link to the waiver will be included in your confirmation email. We recommend completing all waivers before your scheduled activity to help expedite check-in.

Some activities and rentals have minimum age requirements. Please provide accurate participant ages when booking. Guests who do not meet the age requirement or appear to be under the influence of drugs or alcohol will not be permitted to participate, and no refund will be issued.

Please do not leave personal belongings unattended on the beach or at the pool. Limited storage is available for shoes and towels, but valuables should be left in a secure location. Waikīkī Beach Services and its staff are not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal property.

primary_location.name: Waikīkī Beach Services Royal Hawaiian
primary_location.note:
**Royal Hawaiian Beach Desk**
If you are a guest of the Royal Hawaiian or Sheraton Waikīkī Hotel, the Royal Hawaiian Beach Desk is located on the Royal Hawaiian pool deck and can be accessed by walking through the hotel. 

If you are not a guest of the two Marriott properties above and are joining us, you can use the Beach Access Lane on Kalākaua Ave located between The Cheesecake Factory and Outrigger Waikīkī Hotel. The walkway is lined by surfboards and will take you directly to our beach desk.
